```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)  # for color functions
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
```


```{r read.data}
microbe_betas = read.csv("../data/microbe_betas_sugar_chol_abx_10percent.csv")
q_values = read.csv("../data/microbe_qs_sugar_chol_abx_10percent.csv")

rownames(microbe_betas) = microbe_betas$plot_name
microbe_betas$plot_name <- NULL
microbe_betas$feature <- NULL

rownames(q_values) = q_values$plot_name
q_values$plot_name <- NULL
q_values$feature <- NULL
```


```{r sort.rename.cols}
microbe_betas_sorted <- microbe_betas[order(microbe_betas[, "abx_three"],
                                            decreasing = TRUE), ]
rename_vec <-  c(
  abx_twelve = "3 - 12 mo.",
  abx_three = "0 - 3 mo."
  )

# Renaming for the plot
colnames(microbe_betas_sorted) <- recode(colnames(microbe_betas_sorted),
                                         !!!rename_vec)
```


```{r set.up.significance}
# Significance annotation logic
stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  if (p < 0.01)  return("**")
  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")
  if (p < 0.1)  return("#")
  return("")
}
```

## Set up for heatmap

```{r, define.color.columns}
beta_cols <- c("3 - 12 mo.", "0 - 3 mo.")

### Create matrix
beta_matrix <- as.matrix(microbe_betas_sorted[, beta_cols])
rownames(beta_matrix) <- rownames(microbe_betas_sorted)

q_matrix <- as.matrix(q_values)
qval_mat <- q_matrix[rownames(microbe_betas_sorted), ]

phyla_colors <- c(
  "Actinobacteria"   = "#9400D3",
  "Bacteroidetes"    = "#FF8C00",
  "Cyanobacteria"    = "#00FFE2",
  "Firmicutes"       = "#4682B4",
  "Fusobacteria"     = "#DC143C",
  "Lentisphaerae"    = "#C1AD09",
  "Patescibacteria"  = "#FF69B4",
  "Proteobacteria"   = "#33a02c",
  "Tenericutes"      = "#FFFF00",
  "Verrucomicrobia"  = "#A0522D",
  "Epsilonbacteraeota" = "#AEDF12",
  "Synergistetes" = "#D2B48C",
  "Euryarchaeota" = "#FFE2FD"
  )

anno_phyla <- microbe_betas_sorted$Phylum           # categorical
anno_prevalence <- microbe_betas_sorted$prevalence  # continuous

cont_colors <- colorRamp2(c(min(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
                            median(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
                            max(anno_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)),
                          c("lightgrey", "dimgrey", "black"))

beta_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#313695FF", "white", "#A50026FF")) #"#FFF0F5"
```

## Circos plot
```{r}
pdf("../figures/circos_CLR.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 7)
circos.clear(); circos.par(RESET = TRUE)
circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.degree = 10, cell.padding = c(0,0,0,0))

# OR heatmap
circos.heatmap(beta_matrix, col = beta_col_fun, na.col = "darkgrey",
               cluster = FALSE,
               rownames.side = "outside", rownames.cex = 0.5,
               track.height = 0.1, bg.border = "black", bg.lwd = 0.4
               )
beta_track <- get.current.track.index()

# Add significance stars into the OR track
n_col <- ncol(beta_matrix)
circos.track(track.index = beta_track, bg.border = NA, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
  ind <- CELL_META$subset[CELL_META$row_order]
  for (j in seq_len(n_col)) {
    lab <- vapply(ind, function(i) stars(qval_mat[i, j]), character(1))
    circos.text(seq_along(ind) - 0.5, rep(j - 0.5, length(ind)), lab,
                cex = 0.4, col = "black",
                facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE)
  }
})

# Prevalence
prev_mat <- matrix(microbe_betas_sorted$prevalence, ncol = 1,
                   dimnames = list(rownames(beta_matrix), "Prevalence"))
circos.heatmap(prev_mat, col = cont_colors, cluster = FALSE,
               track.height = 0.03, bg.border = "black", bg.lwd = 0.1)

# Phyla
phy_mat <- matrix(microbe_betas_sorted$Phylum, ncol = 1,
                  dimnames = list(rownames(beta_matrix), "Phylum"))
circos.heatmap(phy_mat, col = phyla_colors, cluster = FALSE,
               track.height = 0.03, bg.border = "black", bg.lwd = 0.1)

# legends
lgd_or <- Legend(title = "Beta Coefficient", col_fun = beta_col_fun,
                 title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
                 legend_height = unit(2, "cm"),      # bar length (continuous)
                 grid_width    = unit(3, "mm"),      # bar thickness
                 title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

lgd_prev <- Legend(title = "Prevalence", col_fun = cont_colors,
                   title_position = "leftcenter-rot",
                   legend_height = unit(2, "cm"), grid_width = unit(3, "mm"),
                   title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
                   labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

lgd_phy <- Legend(title = "Phylum", legend_gp = gpar(fill = phyla_colors),
                  labels = names(phyla_colors), title_position = "topleft",
                  grid_height = unit(3, "mm"),        # swatch size (discrete)
                  grid_width  = unit(3, "mm"),
                  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
                  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))

draw(packLegend(lgd_or, lgd_prev, lgd_phy, gap = unit(4, "mm")),
     x = unit(0.88, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), just = "left")
circos.clear()
dev.off()
```

### Old



```{r heatmap.plot, fig.height=11.5, fig.width=4.25}
beta_cols <- c("0 - 3 mo.","3 - 12 mo.")

### Create matrix
beta_matrix <- as.matrix(microbe_betas_sorted[, beta_cols])
rownames(beta_matrix) <- rownames(microbe_betas_sorted)

q_matrix <- as.matrix(q_values)
qval_mat <- q_matrix[rownames(microbe_betas_sorted), ]

# make row annotation
row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  Prevalence = anno_prevalence,
  Phylum = anno_phyla,
  col = list(
    Prevalence = cont_colors,
    Phylum = phyla_colors),
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_name_rot = 45,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface="bold"),
  gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.1)
)

ht_beta <- Heatmap(beta_matrix,
                   name = "Beta coefficient",
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(
                     title = "Beta coefficient",
                     title_position = "topleft"),
                   left_annotation = row_anno,
                   col = beta_col_fun,
                   na_col = "lightgrey",
                   column_names_rot = 45,
                   column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                   column_gap = unit(2, "mm"),
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   cluster_columns = FALSE,
                   show_row_names = TRUE,
                   row_names_side = "left",
                   row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
                   rect_gp = gpar(col = "darkgrey", lwd = 0.1),
                   height = unit(nrow(microbe_betas_sorted) * 3.5, "mm"),
                   cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                     pval <- qval_mat[i, j]
                     star <- stars(pval)
                     grid.text(star, x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black"))}
                   )

ht_beta
```

```{r save.fig.not.imp}
pdf("../figures/microbe_heatmap_sorted_three_mo_10percent.pdf",
    width = 4.3, height = 11.5)
draw(ht_beta)
dev.off()
```
